project_tracker_diagnostic: Blue-green/glaucous obovate to elliptic leaves, pale papery/scaly bark, and small oblong/barrel-shaped acorns often flattened at both ends.
verified_target_counties: Hays; Travis; Blanco; Comal; Bandera; Edwards; Gillespie; Kerr; Real; Uvalde; Val Verde

morphology_keys.habit: Small deciduous tree, often on limestone hills, canyons, streamsides, and Edwards Plateau woodlands.
morphology_keys.leaves: Blue-green/glaucous, obovate or elliptic; margin entire to shallowly lobed; underside whitish/glaucous with stellate hairs when young.
morphology_keys.acorn: Cup shallow; nut oblong or barrel-shaped and often flattened at both ends.

photo_strategy.oak_specific_tightening: Prioritize multi-photo late-summer/fall observations to increase the chance of mature leaves and acorns, plus curated taxon reference photos.
